data.transform:
return `
SELECT 
  t.billingaddress,
  t.currency,
  t.duedate,
  t.entity,
  t.id,
  t.memo,
  t.number,
  t.ordreceived,
  t.outsourced,
  t.status,
  t.shipdate,
  t.shippingaddress,
  t.status,
  t.trandate,
  t.tranid,
  t.type,
  t.void,
  t.otherrefnum,
  l.actualshipdate,
  l.foreignamount,
  l.expectedreceiptdate,
  l.expectedshipdate,
  l.id as lineid,
  l.isbillable,
  l.isclosed,
  l.isfullyshipped,
  l.item,
  l.linesequencenumber,
  l.location,
  l.mainline,
  l.memo linememo,
  l.quantity,
  l.rate,
  l.quantityshiprecv,
  l.uniquekey,
  l.units,
  l.subsidiary,
  l.taxline,
  i.itemtype,

FROM transaction t
JOIN transactionline l 
  ON t.id=l.transaction 
LEFT JOIN item i
  ON i.id=l.item
WHERE 
  t.id=${$state.context.REQUEST.DATA.id}
AND
  l.kitmemberof is null 
AND
  l.taxline='F'
`
